Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team is enthusiastic. Attached are our redlines to the Order Form (VelvetOrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf). Before we proceed to signatures we need clarity on three commercial points so procurement can issue a PO: 

1) Which Redwood legal entity will be listed as the invoicing party for the pilot (US vs EMEA)?
2) Minimum commit: we proposed a 3-month consumption commitment in the redline; please confirm acceptance or a proposed fallback invoicing cadence.
3) Net terms: procurement prefers Net45. We need confirmation whether Redwood can accept Net45 and how that impacts invoicing (one consolidated invoice vs monthly invoices).

Also, our legal has asked for confirmation on VAT treatment / reverse charge if we map to an EU entity. Marcus from legal is looped.

Can you confirm the above and send a clean Order Form once aligned — we'll route to our PO team.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Commercials and invoice routing for Redwood pilot

Lydia — thanks for the redlines and clear asks. Quick answers and proposed path: 

1) Invoicing entity: Redwood prefers to invoice from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) for the pilot. If VelvetHealth requires EU invoicing for VAT purposes we can route to Redwood Inference Ltd (EMEA). Please confirm which entity you need on the invoice; we will provide tax residency evidence for EMEA if requested.

2) Minimum commit: we can accept the 3-month commitment as a pilot minimum. Operationally we suggest invoicing monthly against consumption and a reconciliation invoice at pilot close if you hit the commit floor — this keeps your cashflow predictable. If you prefer a single upfront invoice for the entire commit we can discuss but would need to structure as prepay/advance credit (legal/finance approval required).

3) Net terms: Redwood standard for self-serve pilots is Net30. We can offer Net45 for enterprise pilot contracts on a case-by-case basis. Ben — can you confirm whether Sales can approve Net45 for D-20270903-VH or whether we need finance sign-off? Tessa — can you flag any finance constraints (VAT reporting / invoicing frequency) if we move to Net45?

Next steps: I will have Legal prepare a clean Order Form with the selected invoicing entity and the monthly invoicing + reconciliation option called out. If VelvetHealth confirms entity and PO timing we can route to DocuSign.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Net45 is acceptable from our side for the pilot but we need explicit language in the Order Form stating invoice cadence (monthly) and the reconciliation process if the minimum commit is unmet. 
- For procurement: please include a dedicated invoice contact and the exact remit-to address in the final Order Form so our PO team can map correctly. PO issuance is contingent on those fields.
